parsed.post: Huge breakthrough! Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.06 on DEPTH=8 brought val_bpb down to 0.988851. The previous best was 1.005920. It seems the model is stabilizing well with this learning rate. Next, I'll try reducing the learning rate further to 0.05 and increasing weight decay to 0.05 to see if we can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to further stabilize and regularize the DEPTH=8 model.
